summary: The note surveys the surge of GreenTech startups since September 2023, covering rising global venture investment, founding rates, and government support such as the European Green Act. It profiles startups in agriculture, energy, AI, waste management, transportation, and construction, and notes the role of the Green Investment Coalition in funding the sector.
one_line: Overview of the GreenTech startup boom since late 2023, with funding data, policy support, and sector-by-sector examples of notable companies.
key_facts: Venture capital in GreenTech startups grew from $6.8 billion in Q1 2021 to $24.7 billion by the end of Q2 2024, according to the International Finance Corporation.
Startup Genome data suggests over 1,500 new GreenTech ventures were founded worldwide in 2023, a 60% increase from the previous year.
Phytoform Labs was founded in February 2024 by William Lauder and Dr. Clara Forsythe and works on plant genetics to create crops more adaptable to changing climates.
Enerdaptive, founded by Rajesh Singh and Ayesha Chaudry in December 2023, makes adaptive energy systems that optimize energy consumption for large-scale manufacturers.
The European Green Act, enacted October 15, 2023, allocated $100 billion towards GreenTech development across the European Union over the next decade.
The European Green Act introduced a 'GreenTech Fast Track' program to expedite patent applications for green inventions.
On June 5, 2024, SunHarvest deployed organic photovoltaic cells with energy conversion efficiency rivaling traditional silicon solar cells at a fraction of the cost.
EcoAnalytics launched its AI-powered sustainability engine in April 2024, adopted by over 200 companies to reduce resource waste.
BioReCycle introduced enzymatic decomposition technology in January 2024 that breaks down plastic waste into biodegradable compounds.
VoltWheels debuted its prototype electric scooter in March 2024 and received 10,000 pre-orders within the first month.
BuildGreen's composite material uses recycled plastics and organic fibers; since its September 2023 launch it has contributed to over 50 eco-friendly buildings.
The Green Investment Coalition, established in late 2023, is made up of heavyweight investors prioritizing GreenTech funding.
